copy.tagline: 通过 Chat SDK 为应用接入 Google Chat 渠道。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在开发应用并想让它能收发 Google Chat 消息。
copy.tagline_en: Add Google Chat integration to your app via the Chat SDK.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building an app and need Google Chat messaging.

howto.what: 该技能让 Claude 在 NanoClaw 中接入 Google Chat 通道：复制适配器和测试文件、注册到通道索引、安装固定版本的依赖包，最后自动构建并运行测试验证。
howto.when: 当用户要求接入或添加 gchat 通道时触发。

say.text: 请把 Google Chat 通道加进 NanoClaw。
say.note: 执行适配器复制与注册。

say.text: 帮我集成 Google Chat 到项目里。
say.note: 运行添加通道的整套步骤。

say.text: 添加 gchat 通道并跑通测试。

howto.what_en: This skill makes Claude add Google Chat to NanoClaw: copy the gchat adapter and its test, register it in the channel index, install a pinned dependency, then build and run the integration test.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to add or integrate the gchat channel.

say_en.text: Please add the Google Chat channel to NanoClaw.
say_en.note: Runs the adapter copy and registration.

say_en.text: Help me integrate Google Chat into the project.
Add the gchat channel and pass the test.
say_en.note: Builds and runs the integration test.
